CFML Language Reference: Functions

StripCR

Returns the string with every carriage-return character (Chr(13)) deleted. Line feeds are kept.

Category

String functions

Syntax

StripCR(string)

Parameters

string
The string to clean up.

Returns

The string without carriage returns.

Usage

Text typed into a TEXTAREA by a Windows or Macintosh browser arrives with CR/LF line endings. Strip the CRs before saving it to a file read by Unix programs, or before comparing it with text from elsewhere.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Msg = "Line one" & Chr(13) & Chr(10) & "Line two" & Chr(13) & Chr(10)>
<CFSET Clean = StripCR(Msg)>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Before: #Len(Msg)# characters</P>
<P>After StripCR: #Len(Clean)# characters</P>
<PRE>#Clean#</PRE>
</CFOUTPUT>

Chr, Trim, ParagraphFormat, Replace
